answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded ledger account whose registration kernel enforces a unique proof-of-stake deposit, making mass identity creation capital-expensive rather than free. Like water vanishing into karst, sybil registrations drain attacker liquidity, while honest agents share a verified oasis of low-fee trust anchored in audited collateral. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
